title: Commodities Brief — 06 Aug 2026
intro:
Precious metals surge across the board with gold breaching $4,300 as safe-haven flows dominate amid escalating geopolitical tensions and renewed dollar weakness. Energy complex diverges sharply with crude losing ground on demand concerns while metals benefit from industrial restocking and monetary policy expectations.
🥇 PRECIOUS METALS
Gold $4,319.60 +1.74% intraday | Bias: LONG | Key levels: $4,280 support / $4,360 resistance. Seven-week gain of 7.09% reflects sustained institutional buying and central bank accumulation. Silver $62.11 +0.02% consolidating after 7.70% weekly surge, holding critical $61 floor with industrial demand supporting baseline. Platinum $1,763.50 +1.50% and Palladium $1,377.50 +0.94% outperforming on supply tightness and automotive sector recovery signals. PGM complex showing strongest momentum with palladium up 10.12% on the week.

sections.heading: ⚡ ENERGY
sections.content:
WTI $75.15 -0.09% | Bias: BEARISH | Key levels: $73.50 / $77.00. Brent $79.58 +0.16% showing relative strength but both grades under pressure from demand destruction fears and rising inventories. Six-week decline of 6.46% for WTI reflects oversupply narrative. Brent-WTI spread at $4.43 indicates persistent Atlantic basin tightness versus US oversupply. Natural Gas $2.69 -0.09% trending lower on mild weather forecasts and elevated storage levels.
🌾 AGRICULTURE
Corn $460.00 +5.32% leading grain rally on adverse Midwest weather patterns threatening pollination stage. Soybeans $1,174.75 +2.02% supported by strong Chinese import data and South American crop concerns. Wheat $640.00 -0.35% lagging on improved Black Sea export corridors and harvest pressure.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Gold entry $4,310 / SL $4,265 / TP $4,420 — momentum continuation play on technical breakout and Fed pivot expectations.
LONG: Corn entry $458 / SL $448 / TP $485 — weather premium expansion with crop stress intensifying through critical August period.
SHORT: WTI entry $75.80 / SL $77.50 / TP $71.50 — demand weakness accelerating with inventory builds confirming oversupply scenario.

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content:
Dollar reversal on hawkish Fed communications would pressure entire precious metals complex and eliminate current momentum tailwinds.
Rapid geopolitical de-escalation could trigger sharp profit-taking across safe-haven assets while boosting risk appetite and crude demand outlook.
